Eidz3t6qmk.text:
• Problem: feed-forward 3D reconstruction transformers scale past a billion parameters; depth may just buy implicit iterative refinement.
• Key idea: make iteration explicit by looping one shared transformer block K times over per-view DINOv2 features.
• Method: time-conditioned gated block with frame and global attention; depth, ray, and camera heads decode the final state.
• Training samples K from Beta(2,1) on [8,16], so one checkpoint exposes steps as an inference compute knob.
• Setup: 117M-parameter ViT-B model, 29 public datasets, evaluated on DTU, ETH3D, 7-Scenes, ScanNet++, and nuScenes.
• Results: best average IR (80.3%) and AUC@30 (91.8%) versus VGGT, Pi3, and DA3-G, using 75.9 TFLOPs and 4.9 GiB.
• New: shared weights beat untied per-step blocks (AUC@3 30.2 vs 23.0), but performance degrades well beyond 16 steps.

zSwgtp9S5a.text:
• Problem: web-scale pretraining hides prior exposure, so we can't tell whether interventions create or elicit capabilities.
• Key idea: constrain the training data itself to U.S. K–5 curriculum, creating an interpretable knowledge boundary.
• Method: AoA prefilter, LLM-judge-trained FastText/ModernBERT classifiers, symbolic filtering, and frequency sampling on FineWeb-Edu yield an 88B-token corpus.
• Validation: 0% Beyond-K–5 retained on CommonCoreText, 2.48% on WeeBit, 35–42% of K–5 retained.
• Setup: 5B Qwen3-style LittleLearner trained 100h on 8 B200s, compared to an Unfiltered twin and Gemma 2B.
• Results: matches Unfiltered on K–5 math; at Grade 8 pass@1024 it solves under half as many problems.
• Scaling, SFT+GRPO, and few-shot ICL boost in-scope skills but don't lift out-of-scope performance; the corpus and model are released as a sandbox.
